overview.about: The Ford Championship is an LPGA event in the Phoenix area of Arizona, part of the tour's spring desert swing. Warm, dry conditions and generous resort-style courses make it a scoring-friendly week under blue desert skies.
overview.nextEvent: The next Ford Championship is played in the Arizona desert near Phoenix. The sunny spring conditions and receptive greens tend to produce low, aggressive scoring.
